description: The Delannoy number D(m,n), the number of paths from (0,0) to (m,n) using steps (1,0), (0,1), and (1,1). D(3,5) is 231. m and n run from 0 to 64. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/delannoy
